ORDINANCE
BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO

SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is hereby
amended by changing all of the B3-3 Community Shopping District symbols and indications as shown on

Map No. 10-D in an area bound by:

A line 148.30 feet south of and parallel to 43" Street; the public alley next east of and parallel to Cottage

Grove Avenue; a line 198.30 feet south of and parallel to 43" Street; and Cottage Grove Avenue.

To those of a C1-3 Neighborhood Commercial District

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and due publication.

Common Address of Property: 4315-17 S Cottage Grove Ave, Chicago, IL 60653
